sweep_recipe.notes: CONTACT-CONDITIONED surrogate, 40 channels: the 34 base plus pos_z_m, vel_body_z_mps and the four foot_*_in_contact indicators. The model predicts every channel it conditions on, so the contact mode is both PREDICTED and CONDITIONED ON -- conditioning alone is insufficient because in a rollout the future mode is unknown. sigma 0.05 to match the full-noise baseline: at that sigma the gate's apparatus at 0.5 s is already 0.33, comfortably clear of 1.0, so the conditioned model needs only corr >= 0.5 to PASS outright and ONE quantity has to move. That choice and its reasoning were recorded before training. CRITERION: succeed by landing OFF the measured noise trade-off curve -- an (apparatus, corr) pair at 0.5 s that no noise magnitude achieves. The curve is sigma 0: (1.12, 0.202), sigma 0.025: (1.03, 0.409), sigma 0.05: (0.33, 0.181). Sliding along it, better on one and worse on the other, is the existing trade-off and is NOT evidence conditioning helps. LIMITATION: the indicators are binary but this is a delta model, so predicted contact is prev+delta and can leave [0,1]. A relaxation, not a mode classifier.
